bibliographic.title: Under the sun
bibliographic.author: kwon bohyoun, Oh Youngjin
bibliographic.description:
A story of friendship and solidarity between an ordinary middle school girl living in Korea and a Syrian refugee classmate crossing borders and races.

YounJin has been transferred from Seoul to Ansan. She meets Sarah, a refugee girl from Syria, at a new school. Sarah welcomes you with a joyful smile. Always bright and lively, Sarah was a lot different from the helpless and hopeless figure YounJin had for the refugees. Sarah is also the representative of the art classroom, but she lives with the story of a sick Syria. Two friends who have become friends. Yeonjin thinks there is something to do to help her childhood friend Yalda who has not escaped from Syria. What do Junjin and Sarah and her friends do for Syria?
